launch.note: $DEFICIT was created on mainnet on 2026-10-13 through the Burnticker LaunchLab platform. Its rules were locked on chain first (rules sha256 8e3e8b66…), then the coin was created, then 3 SOL was seeded into its burn pool as a disclosed gift. The keeper signed the baseline reading the same evening.

rehearsal.note: The devnet rehearsal coin ran at 1% per $1B (the mainnet rule is 2%); its two executed burns are real devnet transactions anyone can check.

firstBurnPath.line: Nothing burns until the curve fills and the debt rises. $DEFICIT first has to graduate at 85 SOL raised, and its pool has to be registered and verified. Only then can a Treasury reading with at least one full $1B unit start a burn.

demo.summary: Treasury's Debt to the Penny rose $23.92B from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-06, which is 23 units. The rule asked for 0.104 SOL of the 0.506 SOL burn pool. One crank may spend at most 2% of the trading pool's SOL reserve, so 0.0201 SOL bought 4,010,874.87 $DEFICIT. Every token bought was burned in the same transaction, and the rest carried over to the next crank.

phase.label: soft launch ($DEFICIT created on mainnet)
phase.line: Burnticker is in soft launch. Both programs were deployed on mainnet on 2026-10-11 and upgraded to round 4 (end sinks and pairs) on 2026-10-12 through the Squads vault, which holds the upgrade authority. $DEFICIT, the operator's first coin, was created on mainnet on 2026-10-13 and is on its curve; its keeper signs each Treasury reading. Creator launches opened the same evening, and the first coin made through the site, $PHINFLWIN, was created that night. $REHEARSAL, a test coin the operator made on Oct 11 to check fees and signing. It is listed so you can see it exists, not so you trade it.

mainnet.why: The owner decided on 2026-10-11, and again on 2026-10-12, to keep the mainnet vault's time lock at 0 through launch week, so that deploy and config fixes are not delayed. It is to be raised to 48 h at least a week after the soft launch. Until then, a 2-of-3 vote can act at once.
mainnet.keyControl: The vault has three keys but only two controllers. The owner holds members A and B, which are two of the three keys, so the owner alone meets the 2-of-3 threshold. Member C is a person outside the operator who holds the third key and is not named publicly. While the owner holds two keys, the third key adds no independent approval.

releaseRequirements.text: Deploy both programs on mainnet with the Squads vault as upgrade authority. This was done on 2026-10-11; the record is docs/burnkeeper/evidence/mainnet-deploy-2026-10-11/deploy.json.
Make the first real burn on mainnet with $REHEARSAL.
Add an independent second signer before strangers can launch.
Build the end-of-rule sink (program round 4). It is built and deployed on mainnet and devnet, with a devnet run on record.
Get an independent re-check of the round 4 programs (pair-forward and end sinks) now that they are deployed on mainnet.
Raise the mainnet Squads time lock from 0 to 48 h. The owner's decision is to do this at least a week after the soft launch.
Set up the TheSportsDB license key for sports settlement. This was done on 2026-10-11, and the key is set on the mainnet host.
Reproduce the verified build in solana-verify's Docker image.
Sign the operator's statement with the developer fee wallet.
Compile the mainnet operator treasury and LaunchLab platform into both programs.

design: Rules are locked at launch; a different rule is a different coin.

In a pair, the winner takes the burn. Fees from both coins burn the winner's supply. The round 4 program carries this on devnet and mainnet; the host flag for pair launches is on, and creator launches have been open since the evening of 2026-10-13.

When a rule ends and resolves, its leftover burn pool goes to a sink, which is the contest's winner or else $DEFICIT. The round 4 program carries this on devnet and mainnet; it has run on devnet (the devnet round 4 evidence folder), and no mainnet rule has ended yet.
The Squads 2-of-3 vault holds the upgrade authority. As the last step it is to be set to none, which is not done yet.
